events.message: We take our dough and fruit to the dairy and bakehouse. The pressed juice and flatbread remain at the roadside hearth. We collect the things needed for this scene along the way.
Place Yeast culture at Fermentation room, then bring Dough onto Yeast culture. Only the receiving thing needs to be placed there.
Leavened dough. Yeast changes the dough over time; the game compresses fermentation.
Yogurt. A suitable bacterial culture transforms milk; it is not the same culture as bread yeast.
Fruit yogurt. Stir fruit into the yogurt. Neither ingredient is retired: both still have other uses.
Bread and butter. Spread butter on the bread. This optional discovery is not a quota or a gate.

We bring the pastry ingredients and a loaf to the workshop. Cream and the churn come from the dairy; yogurt stays there unless we return for it. We collect the things needed for this scene along the way.
Humoral menu. A period menu organized through hot/cold and wet/dry qualities. This records a historical belief, not a medically effective diet.
Annotated menu. A museum annotation distinguishes a historical explanatory system from present-day nutrition; neither is a literal ingredient.
Shortcrust. Rubbing fat into flour makes a short pastry; water and handling are compressed here.
Laminated dough. Cold butter is folded through dough in separate layers; this is not simply stirred together.

playerReport: Voluntary stop after satisfying stage 3 pastry goals; not blocked. Opening causal chains were intuitive but routine. Failed dough plus yeast taught the receiving-item placement rule clearly, and I generalized it to yogurt and pastry. Optional fruit yogurt and bread and butter were the most satisfying discoveries because they answered my own ideas rather than a quota. Humoral book plus modern nutrition note failed; one hint led to the menu branch, whose abstract annotation was less rewarding than a concrete historical example would have been. Butter into flour versus dough was recognizable, but the repeated place-combine-bake pattern now feels routine. I do not feel enough curiosity to continue to snack cake today. This is one source-blind logical-interface agent playtest, not a human enjoyment claim.
